raw_text: Breaking: ISRO Bengaluru data centre targeted by sophisticated spear-phishing campaign days after Chandrayaan-3 lunar landing. Sources say emails impersonated senior ISRO scientists. Attackers attempted lateral movement toward mission control networks. CERT-In reportedly issuing emergency advisory to all space sector entities.
clean_text: ISRO Bengaluru data centre targeted by spear-phishing campaign after Chandrayaan-3 landing. Attackers impersonated ISRO scientists, attempted access to mission control. CERT-In issuing advisory.
